_about: Muzzy's art on the screens (F19). Files are served from public/art/ — made from art/ by `node scripts/art-prep.mjs` (re-run it after changing a file in art/). Button size: s / m / l = picture 3 / 4 / 5.5rem wide. Frame: slice = where its corners end, in the picture's own units (top, right, bottom, left); scale = rem per picture unit (0.0375 ≈ the picture at 60%); ink = the words' colour on the frame's screen. Which art file is what: .planning/research/art-map.md

console._about: The console = the main menu (F21), drawn from Muzzy's mock-up art/Example1.svg. Every number is in that file's own units (its viewBox: 648 wide). size = the whole mock-up; view = the part that shows (the phone-shaped page, from the monitor's bottom edge down to the footer — the GOOPS title and the gear sit under it, written by the game); viewShort = the part shown on a phone on its side (down to the bottom of the laser panel). layers = groups cut out of the mock-up by art-prep, each at its box `at` [x, y, width, height]; strip = bits taken out (they'd show fake numbers or do nothing). periscope.travel = how far it pulls down, as a share of its own height (Example3 has it 362 units lower); grip = the share of it (from the bottom: goggles + bar + arrow) you can grab — its long stem hides behind the monitor. words = where the game writes words over the art: `at` + `text` (letter size in mock-up units).

repairs._about: F24: the repair panels' moving parts, drawn by the game over the panels (art-prep strips the same parts out of them: stripClasses = the knobs, the dial face and the lamps; strip = the three arcade buttons). Boxes are [x, y, width, height] in the mock-up's units, read off Example1.svg. viewShort = what a phone on its side shows mid-shift: just the three panels (the way back is then the Back to the tank button). knob = the slider knob's share of its track (50.23 / 175.86). Laser: sliders in the order row 1 left, row 1 right, row 2 left, row 2 right, each with its two lamps [left end, right end]. Controls: the dial, its four corner lamps (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left) and the angle (degrees clockwise from up) the dial's arrow points at each. Visor (RESET LIGHTS): the up/down slider, its top lamp and a bottom lamp (in the track's bottom end: the knob covers it when it's down — there's no room under the track), and the three buttons top to bottom with their lamps.
